<table style="width: 100%;"><tr><td>build_jsdm_variance_partition_method</td><td style="text-align: right;">R Documentation</td></tr></table>

<h2>Build the sjSDM Variance-Partition Method for One Model</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Returns the installed sjSDM 1.0.7 ANOVA method, unchanged, but evaluated in
a private environment in which every sub-model inherits the association
penalty and the seed of the full model.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_jsdm_variance_partition_method(
  mod,
  anova_function = NULL,
  fit_function = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="mod">mod</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fitted sjSDM object whose variance is partitioned.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="anova_function">anova_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional ANOVA method to evaluate instead of the installed
'sjSDM:::anova.sjSDM()'. Intended for tests.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fit_function">fit_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional model-fitting function called by the cloned update method instead
of the installed 'sjSDM::sjSDM()'. Intended for tests.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>'sjSDM:::anova.sjSDM()' refits each sub-model with
'update(object, ..., biotic = bioticStruct(diag = ...))'. A default
'bioticStruct()' has 'lambda = 0', so sub-models containing the association
component lose the association penalty of the full model, and
'update.sjSDM()' falls back to the default sjSDM seed (issue #203).
</p>
<p>This builder clones the ANOVA closure without editing its body. The clone's
environment is a child of the sjSDM namespace that binds:
- &lsquo;bioticStruct' to a partial application carrying the full model&rsquo;s
'lambda' ('l1_cov + l2_cov'), 'alpha' ('l2_cov / lambda', or the sjSDM
default when 'lambda' is zero), 'on_diag', 'reg_on_Cov', 'inverse', and
'df', while the caller still sets 'diag';
- 'update' to a clone of 'update.sjSDM()' whose own environment binds
&lsquo;sjSDM' to a partial application carrying the full model&rsquo;s 'seed'.
'update.sjSDM()' re-evaluates its arguments through 'match.call()', so a
forwarding wrapper around it would pass unevaluable '..N' symbols.
</p>
<p>The function fails closed when the installed sjSDM version, the bodies of
'anova.sjSDM()' and 'update.sjSDM()', or the formals and body of
'bioticStruct()' differ from the versions this adapter was written for.
No package namespace or installed file is modified.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A function with the formals of 'anova.sjSDM()' ('object', 'samples',
'verbose', '...') that returns an 'sjSDManova' object.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[compute_jsdm_variance_partition()],
[compute_jsdm_variance_partition_with_progress()]
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
method_partition &lt;-
  build_jsdm_variance_partition_method(mod = mod_jsdm)
method_partition(object = mod_jsdm, samples = 1000L, verbose = FALSE)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>

</main>
